scope: Base NSIS NLF strings only; MUI strings and activation remain pending

messages.source: I &accept the terms of the License Agreement
messages.translation: Nina&kubali masharti ya makubaliano ya leseni

messages.source: I &do not accept the terms of the License Agreement
messages.translation: Si&kubali masharti ya makubaliano ya leseni

messages.source: Click Install to start the installation.
Click Uninstall to start the uninstallation.
Please review the license agreement before installing $(^NameDA). If you accept all terms of the agreement, click I Agree.
messages.translation: Soma makubaliano ya leseni kabla ya kusakinisha $(^NameDA). Ukikubali masharti yote, bofya Ninakubali.

messages.source: Please review the license agreement before installing $(^NameDA). If you accept all terms of the agreement, click the check box below. $_CLICK
messages.translation: Soma makubaliano ya leseni kabla ya kusakinisha $(^NameDA). Ukikubali masharti yote, weka alama kwenye kisanduku hapa chini. $_CLICK

messages.source: Please review the license agreement before installing $(^NameDA). If you accept all terms of the agreement, select the first option below. $_CLICK
messages.translation: Soma makubaliano ya leseni kabla ya kusakinisha $(^NameDA). Ukikubali masharti yote, chagua chaguo la kwanza hapa chini. $_CLICK

messages.source: Please review the license agreement before uninstalling $(^NameDA). If you accept all terms of the agreement, click I Agree.
messages.translation: Soma makubaliano ya leseni kabla ya kuondoa $(^NameDA). Ukikubali masharti yote, bofya Ninakubali.

messages.source: Please review the license agreement before uninstalling $(^NameDA). If you accept all terms of the agreement, click the check box below. $_CLICK
messages.translation: Soma makubaliano ya leseni kabla ya kuondoa $(^NameDA). Ukikubali masharti yote, weka alama kwenye kisanduku hapa chini. $_CLICK

messages.source: Please review the license agreement before uninstalling $(^NameDA). If you accept all terms of the agreement, select the first option below. $_CLICK
messages.translation: Soma makubaliano ya leseni kabla ya kuondoa $(^NameDA). Ukikubali masharti yote, chagua chaguo la kwanza hapa chini. $_CLICK

messages.source: Check the components you want to install and uncheck the components you don't want to install. $_CLICK
messages.translation: Weka alama kwenye vipengele unavyotaka kusakinisha na ondoa alama kwenye vile usivyotaka. $_CLICK

messages.source: Or, select the optional components you wish to install:
messages.translation: Au chagua vipengele vya hiari unavyotaka kusakinisha:

messages.source: Check the components you want to uninstall and uncheck the components you don't want to uninstall. $_CLICK
messages.translation: Weka alama kwenye vipengele unavyotaka kuondoa na ondoa alama kwenye vile usivyotaka kuondoa. $_CLICK

messages.source: Or, select the optional components you wish to uninstall:
messages.translation: Au chagua vipengele vya hiari unavyotaka kuondoa:

messages.source: Setup will install $(^NameDA) in the following folder. To install in a different folder, click Browse and select another folder. $_CLICK
messages.translation: $(^NameDA) itasakinishwa kwenye folda ifuatayo. Ili kutumia folda nyingine, bofya Vinjari na uchague folda nyingine. $_CLICK

messages.source: Select the folder to install $(^NameDA) in:
Setup will uninstall $(^NameDA) from the following folder. To uninstall from a different folder, click Browse and select another folder. $_CLICK
messages.translation: $(^NameDA) itaondolewa kwenye folda ifuatayo. Ili kutumia folda nyingine, bofya Vinjari na uchague folda nyingine. $_CLICK

messages.source: Select the folder to uninstall $(^NameDA) from:
$(^NameDA) will be uninstalled from the following folder. $_CLICK
